lines.text: A Maskil of Asaph.
Give ear, O my people, to my instruction;
listen to the words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in parables;
I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
that we have heard and known
and our fathers have relayed to us.
We will not hide them from their children
but will declare to the next generation
the praises of the LORD and His might
and the wonders He has performed.
For He established a testimony in Jacob
and appointed a law in Israel,
which He commanded our fathers
to teach to their children,
that the coming generation would know them—
even children yet to be born—
to arise and tell their own children
that they should put their confidence in God,
not forgetting His works,
but keeping His commandments.
Then they will not be like their fathers,
a stubborn and rebellious generation,
whose heart was not loyal,
whose spirit was not faithful to God.

pictures.scene: Max Liebermann, Der zwölfjährige Jesus im Tempel — the boy standing among the teachers in the temple to hear and to ask, a Maskil of Asaph, give ear O my people to my instruction
pictures.name: pd_liebermann_jesus_im_tempel

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, The Parable of the Mote and the Beam — the saying of the Lord set out as a picture a man can see, listen to the words of my mouth, I will open my mouth in parables
pictures.name: pd_fetti_mote_and_beam

pictures.scene: Salomon Koninck, An Old Philosopher — the old man bent over the book by one candle to find what is written in it, I will utter things hidden from the beginning, that we have heard and known
pictures.name: pd_koninck_old_philosopher

pictures.scene: Józef Szermentowski, Catechism Lesson — the children gathered round to be taught what their fathers were taught, and our fathers have relayed to us, we will not hide them from their children
pictures.name: pd_szermentowski_catechism_lesson

pictures.scene: Peder Balke, Nordkapp — the great headland standing up out of the sea where no man made it, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might
pictures.name: pd_balke_nordkapp

pictures.scene: Anselm Feuerbach, Mirjam — the prophetess with her instrument lifted to sing what God had done, and the wonders He has performed, for He established a testimony in Jacob
pictures.name: pd_feuerbach_miriam

pictures.scene: Konstantin Makovsky, The Appeal of Minin — the man standing up in the square to call the whole people to their duty, and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers
pictures.name: pd_makovsky_appeal_of_minin

pictures.scene: Jacob Willemsz de Wet, Christus zegent de kinderen — the children brought up to the Lord and not turned away, to teach to their children, that the coming generation would know them
pictures.name: pd_dewet_christus_zegent_kinderen

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Maes, Jonge vrouw bij de wieg — the mother keeping watch beside the cradle of the one not yet grown, even children yet to be born, to arise and tell their own children
pictures.name: pd_maes_jonge_vrouw_bij_de_wieg

pictures.scene: Constant Troyon, On the Way to the Market — the day's work taken up again at first light along the road, that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works
pictures.name: pd_troyon_on_the_way_to_the_market

pictures.scene: Bernardus Johannes Blommers, Kinderen van de visser — the fisherman's children keeping together on the shore where they were set, but keeping His commandments, then they will not be like their fathers
pictures.name: pd_blommers_kinderen_van_de_visser

pictures.scene: Honoré Daumier, The Uprising — the crowd carried forward with one man's fist thrown up in the middle of it, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal
pictures.name: pd_daumier_the_uprising

pictures.scene: Jan Davidsz de Heem, Stilleven met boeken — the books piled up and left unopened on the table, whose spirit was not faithful to God, the archers of Ephraim
pictures.name: pd_deheem_stilleven_met_boeken
